scope: characterize the number of O-glycosites that are present in O-glycopeptides derived from the OpeRATOR digestion of four known O-glycoproteins

A mixture of O-glycopeptides generated by sequential OpeRATOR and trypsin digestion was generated using four glycoproteins: bovine fetuin (alpha-2-HS-glycoprotein, P12763), recombinant human CD14 (P08571), human fibronectin (P02751), and recombinant human P-selectin glycoprotein ligand 1 (PSGL1; Q14242).

Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail because it requires a glycan database and specific handling of OpeRATOR cleavage (N-terminal glycosylated S/T). The use of ETD/EThcD is critical for site localization due to the prevalence of multiply glycosylated peptides.
